build.profile: upstream allnoconfig plus pinned echo/cat/wc/printf and ash, static x86_64 Linux ELF
build.configuration: Only upstream Kconfig selections; no source patches or Space-specific libc/syscall wrappers. Ash builtins are upstream shell behavior; external process creation/pipelines require real Linux personality support.
build.resolved_config_receipt: Builder writes complete resolved.config and SHA256, verbose build.log, exact host case oracles and readelf headers into the external output directory.
build.configuration_step: Between allnoconfig and oldconfig, builder writes only the explicit upstream kconfig values below into .config and requires oldconfig retain every requested value.

coverage_goal.runtime_goal: Execute each exact pinned ELF case through real Linux personality CPL3 transitions with exact output/status, private VFS bindings and post-exit cleanup; repeat on standard and minimal roots.
coverage_goal.next_boundary: Preserve both-root repeated acceptance, genuine IRQ/policy/deadlock causes and bounded ownership while expanding executable paths, signal handling and shared-VM/vfork only through real native mechanisms.

current_bounded_coverage.contract: Real copied private children, owned native pipes, wait and bounded self-exec; actual cross-capacity producer/consumer scheduling, exact bytes and cleanup. Arbitrary shared-VM/vfork, installed signal handlers, general executable paths and unrestricted shells are not established.
